title: Malaysian Sausage Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring grilled sausages and juicy vegetables, perfect for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Sausages
ingredients.notes: any type of sausage works well

instructions: Cut sausages into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers.
Alternate adding vegetables to skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush soy sauce, chili flakes, garlic, and lime juice (if using) onto the sausages and vegetables.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the sausages are cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with cilantro or scallions if desired.
